g.title: prolactinoma_qsp
g.text: PROLACTINOMA — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Mechanistic Map
Lactotroph PitNET · dopamine D2 control of secretion AND growth · the measurement layer as pathophysiology
One D2 occupancy equation generates dopamine-agonist efficacy, antipsychotic-induced hyperprolactinaemia, the aripiprazole add-on paradox and stalk-effect disconnection
Three time constants from one receptor: exocytosis (hours) · transcription (weeks) · cytoreduction (months) — split into reversible cell VOLUME and bankable cell NUMBER
Bioactive vs reported prolactin: hook effect (falsely low), macroprolactinaemia (falsely high), PEG recovery · Safety as a 5-HT2B/D2/D3 selectivity ratio
